title: OpenClaw Morning Briefing: Wake Up to Your AI Agent's Daily Report
summary: Set up an OpenClaw morning briefing delivered to Telegram at 7 AM — weather, calendar, top news, and email summary. Full HEARTBEAT.md and SOUL.md setup guide.
body_markdown: On Blink Claw, pricing starts at about $45/month per agent for hosting, uptime, and security patches, and LLM usage is billed from your workspace credits on top. The morning briefing alone uses very little (typically under $0.05/day in LLM usage for a standard briefing). If you self-host OpenClaw, you pay your cloud provider ($5–15/month for a VPS) plus LLM API costs separately.
